title: npm test is red on Windows: two tests assume POSIX (0o600 file mode, 3000 long ref names)
observation: Standalone on Windows 11 / git 2.52.0.windows.1 / Node 24: test/external-acceptance.test.ts:89 asserts statSync(draft).mode & 0o777 === 0o600 and gets 0o666 (438) because Windows has no POSIX mode bits; test/sync.test.ts:623 creates 3000 refs named refs/heads/probe_NNNN_ + 180 x 'x' via git update-ref --stdin, which fails with status 128 (ref path exceeds the Windows path limit). Both pre-date 1.38.0 (files last changed in #226 and 1.32.0) and pass in Linux CI; they are not 1.38 regressions, but they make a local full-suite verification on Windows always red, so the task card always shows a failed check here.
